content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect usage of the variable `collection` instead of `collectionName` when retrieving the alias from the `stateProvider`. This led to the `CloudSolrClient` not expanding the collection parameter correctly, resulting in potential issues when handling collection aliases and queries involving multiple collections or aliases. The patch corrected this by ensuring the correct variable was used to fetch the alias, thereby fixing the alias handling logic in the `CloudSolrClient`.
